summary.text: Scott Surovell is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 34, serving since 2016.
The district covers part of Fairfax County.
Scott Surovell served in the House from 2010 to 2016, and the Senate profile lists Scott Surovell as Senate Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography says Scott Surovell was born in Washington, D.C.
It lists a B.A. from James Madison University and a J.D. from the University of Virginia School of Law.
The biography lists Scott Surovell's occupation as attorney.
Scott Surovell serves on the Courts of Justice Committee (as chair), Commerce and Labor, Finance and Appropriations, Rehabilitation and Social Services, and Rules.
